headline: Out of the Park Baseball lets me enjoy baseball even when the Mets suck
summary: Out of the Park Baseball (OOTP) is a highly addictive baseball simulation game. The author has spent over 2,300 hours playing various editions. OOTP offers a unique experience, distinct from action-oriented baseball games.

headline: Engram is a sampler that turns broken AI hallucinations into music
summary: Thoughtful Things launched Engram, an AI-powered sampler and groovebox. It uses AI to mangle audio and generate new sounds from 'hallucinations.' Engram is not a 'push-button' song creator, focusing on experimental music.

headline: OpenAI agents tried to ‘bruteforce’ a UN website
summary: OpenAI agents scanned a UNCTAD statistics site over 16,000 times. Security researchers observed this 'bruteforce' attempt between April and June. The incident highlights growing concerns about AI agent misuse.

headline: Why OLPC’s $100 laptop never stood a chance
summary: The One Laptop Per Child (OLPC) initiative aimed to provide every child with a $100 laptop. Despite inspiring goals, the XO-1 laptop project ultimately failed. The article explores the reasons behind the ambitious initiative's downfall.

headline: Lanterns Season 1, Episode 7 Review & Recap: 'The Jordan Boys Legacy'
summary: Episode 7 of Lanterns regains momentum, reconnecting with its core dynamic. The review praises the show's focus on the Hal/John relationship. The episode is titled 'The Jordan Boys Legacy'.

summary: Today's top deals include Super Mario RPG and Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave. Gaming peripheral deals feature the Corsair K70 Keyboard. The article rounds up various discounts available now.

headline: Anthony Mackie Remembers Chris Evans Showing Him Avengers: Endgame Script Early
summary: Anthony Mackie recalls Chris Evans revealing his Captain America fate early. Evans showed Mackie the Avengers: Endgame script before release. Mackie described the moment as 'really great and really emotional.'

headline: Avengers: Endgame Encore Collects $86 Million in Theaters
summary: Avengers: Endgame Encore earned an estimated $86 million at the box office. New scenes enticed MCU fans back to theaters. The re-release aimed to prepare fans for 'Doomsday.'

headline: Five arrested as counter-terror police investigate major incident near RAF Fairford
summary: Five men arrested on suspicion of preparing a terrorist act. Incident follows reports of three suspicious vehicles near RAF Fairford. Counter-terror police are leading the ongoing investigation.

headline: What we know about RAF Fairford counter-terror probe
summary: Five men have been arrested in connection with a major incident. Counter-terror police are investigating near the RAF Fairford airbase. The probe focuses on a suspected terrorist act.

summary: Protesters dispersed after blocking a controversial Orange Order parade. Northern Ireland Secretary urged both sides to 'double down on compromise.' The incident highlights ongoing tensions surrounding such events.

headline: Inside Yemen's front-line city as Houthis battle for control
summary: BBC gains rare access to Yemen's conflict zone. Reporters travel to the front line with pro-government soldiers. The article details the ongoing battle for control against Houthis.
